value_flows.description: currencyToken is transferred from msg.sender to AgentRouter, then to bootstrapPool or fraxswapPair.
FraxswapPair.swap() transfers _amountOut of _agentToken to _recipient in exchange for currencyToken.
Agent token (_agentToken) is transferred from msg.sender to AgentRouter, then to bootstrapPool or fraxswapPair.
FraxswapPair.swap() transfers _amountOut of currencyToken to _recipient in exchange for _agentToken.
token (AIToken) address is set, granting Owner (Agent) mint/burn rights on that AIToken.
proxyImplementation is set, changing which logic contract handles all delegatecalls for this Agent.
Initial supply of 100M AIToken is minted to the factory address during construction.
Owner (Agent) can mint new tokens to any address, increasing total supply.
Owner (Agent) can burn tokens from any address, decreasing total supply.

Currency tokens flow from user to pool via safeTransferFrom, agent tokens flow from pool to user via safeTransfer. Fees are added to currencyTokenFeeEarned. Order: fee calculation, transferFrom, transfer.

Agent tokens flow from user to pool via safeTransferFrom, currency tokens flow from pool to user via safeTransfer. Fees are added to agentTokenFeeEarned. Order: fee calculation, transferFrom, transfer, liquidity check.
Pool is permanently disabled. All remaining tokens (including fees) are swept to LiquidityManager.owner(). Order: _sweepFees(), set killed, transfer all tokens.
Accumulated fees (currencyTokenFeeEarned, agentTokenFeeEarned) are transferred to feeTo address. Order: transfer, reset fees to 0.

Voting power flows from token holders to votes. Proposals can modify governor parameters (thresholds, periods, delays) and execute arbitrary calls via agent. Order: propose -> vote -> queue -> execute.

Transfers remaining liquidity and currency to FraxswapPair and mints LP tokens

static_findings_context.analysis: The provided codebase does not contain a LiquidityManager.sol file. This finding references a line in a contract not included in the repository snapshot. Without the contract, cannot map reachability. However, from the call graph summary, AgentRouter interacts with LiquidityManager via factory.agentManager(agent). If LiquidityManager is part of the system and has an external call at line 220, it would be reachable from AgentRouter.buy() or AgentRouter.sell() when the bootstrap pool is not killed. The finding is likely real if the call is to an external contract and the return value is not checked.

static_findings_context.reason: The static finding points to an external call in LiquidityManager.sol (not provided in code) that is likely called from _sweepFees(). Since _sweepFees() transfers tokens to the result of LiquidityManager.owner(), an unchecked external call here could lead to funds being sent to an incorrect address if LiquidityManager is compromised or returns unexpected values. This is a real concern as it affects token transfers in critical fee sweeping operations.

The unchecked external call is in LiquidityManager.sol, which is deployed by AgentFactory via create2. The static finding is about an external call return value not being checked. In the context of AgentFactory, the call to initializeBootstrapPool (line 99) is external and the return value is not checked, but this is a low confidence finding. The static analysis may have flagged a different external call in LiquidityManager.sol that is not directly reachable from AgentFactory entry points, or it may be a false positive due to the use of SafeERC20 elsewhere.
